scenario: LCDB.7.9's negative — the same rule on a schema that DECLARES a `key` slot has a non-empty activation key ([LCDB.3.3.3]), so no warning. Pinned so the check cannot fire on every rate-limited rule and still pass the positive fixture. Path: `dsc.validate.lcdb_7_9_rule_wide_window`, `contributes_no_key` failing on the `key` marker.
rules_ds:
schema ZoneTemp scope logical:
    zone: String key
    celsius: Float mutable

rule hot cooldown 5_min:
    ZoneTemp t where t.celsius > 30.0
->
    log info "hot {t.zone}"
